characters.name: 좀비1_일반좀비
characters.design: Cute adult chibi human-shaped mint slime zombie, approximately3.3heads tall, rounded head/cheeks and soft torso, two short rounded arms/mitten hands and two short legs/feet, small bead eyes, tiny closed wavy mouth, silly sleepy expression, simple broad jelly highlights, no skeletal anatomy.

characters.name: 좀비2_큰좀비
characters.design: Cute large adult chibi HUMAN-shaped pistachio slime zombie, about3heads tall. Rounded head and cheeks, sleepy small bead eyes, tiny closed mouth, soft broad shoulders and very round pear belly, thick soft arms/mitten hands, two stout legs/feet, small amber bubble inside belly; cuddly clumsy heavyweight, no bodybuilder lobes or horror.

characters.name: 슬라임을 뒤집어쓴 일반 사람
characters.design: Cute adult chibi real human under connected turquoise full-body slime, covering one half of the actual face/one eye and cheek. Brown hair, warm exposed half-face, mustard shirt/navy trousers/cream shoes. Dead is shot impact, buckle/fall, then lie on side/back with most slime still present and only a little peeled at one shoulder/chest; no kneeling/help-hand or full release.

user_clarification: Slime MATERIAL / HUMAN ZOMBIE ANATOMY; rescue humans are actual people covered by slime
art_direction: Cute adult chibi humanoids with soft rounded features and pastel slime material; no skull/tendons/teeth or horror
human_coating_revision: Connected full-body cyan coating with one half-face covered; Dead retains most coating while lying down with a small peeled shoulder/chest patch
human_face_coating: one facial half including one eye/cheek covered; other half exposed
